# Jorge Froilan Gimenez Perez

> Software Engineer at Apple. Personal CV for Jorge Froilan Gimenez Perez, a systems-oriented software engineer based in Madrid, Spain. Canonical site: https://gimenezp.dev

Jorge Froilan Gimenez Perez is a 27-year-old Software Engineer focused on backend and AI at Apple. He is based in Madrid, Spain, and previously spent around 5 years working in Seoul, South Korea. He holds Spanish nationality and a Korean F6 visa (no sponsorship required).

- Email: jorge@gimenezp.dev
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jfgp
- CV PDF: https://gimenezp.dev/assets/JorgeFroilanGimenezPerez_CV.pdf

He designs and builds production systems end to end, from architecture through delivery, with backend services and infrastructure at the center. Over more than 7 years that has included distributed systems, data pipelines, Kubernetes and cloud platforms, and AI in production: internal AI agents and MCP tooling, knowledge bases and retrieval systems (RAG) sold to thousands of companies in South Korea, generative AI systems, and an LLM chatbot.

## Work experience

- Software Engineer at Apple — November 2025 to present — Madrid, Spain. Architected data analysis applications and high-throughput distributed data pipelines in Go, Python, TypeScript, and Rust, with PostgreSQL and Redis caching, for executive decision-making on large-scale datasets. Designed and deployed internal AI agents and MCP tooling into cross-team operational workflows. Owned the software infrastructure behind those systems with Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenTelemetry, and shipped them with Jenkins, improving processing efficiency and performance of core applications. Stack: Go, Python, TypeScript, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Jenkins, MCP, SvelteKit. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-apple
- Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, Generative AI Team at PwC — September 2023 to November 2025 — Seoul, South Korea. Designed and built production knowledge bases and retrieval systems (RAG) in Python, TypeScript, Go, and C/C++, with React and Svelte/SvelteKit clients; these products were, and still are, sold to thousands of companies in South Korea. Architected the backends with gRPC on Azure, PostgreSQL and Redis caching, and messaging through RabbitMQ and NATS. Containerized services with Docker and deployed the images to Kubernetes. Owned infrastructure as code with Terraform and CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Stack: Go, Python, TypeScript, C/C++, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, NATS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, React, Svelte, SvelteKit. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-pwc
- Cloud Native Developer at Hospital Clínic de Barcelona — September 2020 to November 2025 — Barcelona, Spain and remote. Led design and delivery of clinical applications used by hundreds of medical professionals, in Python and Go, including the database models and React, Svelte, Next.js, and SvelteKit clients. Architected secure backends for sensitive patient data, with custom encryption, anonymization, and authentication protocols. Deployed the supporting systems on AWS with Kafka, Apache Iceberg, and Redis caching, and owned Terraform and GitHub Actions CI/CD. Stack: Go, Python, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, Redis, AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, React, Next.js, Svelte, SvelteKit. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-clinic
- 3D Web Apps Engineer and Backend Engineer at Funnyworks — April 2023 to September 2023 — Seoul, South Korea. Designed and deployed Web3 integrations and multiplayer game systems in TypeScript and Go for high-traffic corporate partnerships, on AWS with Redis caching. Designed and deployed WebGL interfaces with React, Three.js, and React Three Fiber. Architected and deployed a production LLM chatbot on Discord for a large-scale user community. Stack: Go, TypeScript, Redis, AWS, React, Three.js, React Three Fiber. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-funnyworks
- Fullstack Engineer and Engineering Team Leader at Onoma AI — April 2022 to April 2023 — Seoul, South Korea. Directed an engineering team to architect and scale AI-powered design tools in TypeScript and Go on AWS serverless infrastructure and generative models. Designed the system architecture and deployed the gRPC API pipelines those AI services ran on, integrating SQL, vector databases, and Redis caching. Owned OpenTelemetry telemetry and GitHub Actions CI/CD, and shipped the Next.js and React clients. Stack: Go, TypeScript, gRPC, SQL, Redis, vector databases, AWS, OpenTelemetry, GitHub Actions, Next.js, React. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-onoma
- Fullstack Software Engineer at ASDT Systems EU — January 2020 to January 2023 — Manresa, Spain and remote. Architected and deployed a highly scalable, real-time drone detection and neutralization web platform in TypeScript, Node.js, and Go, with a React client. Designed optimized data models and WebSocket servers, with MongoDB and Redis caching. Engineered the transition from legacy applications to web-based architectures and owned GitHub Actions CI/CD, facilitating adoption by enterprise and government clients. Stack: Go, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, GitHub Actions, React. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-asdt
- R&D Solutions Engineer at The Forest Next — January 2019 to January 2020 — Terrassa, Spain. Developed and deployed machine learning models in Python and Matlab, with SQL, for anomaly detection and predictive maintenance in automotive production lines. Programmed collaborative robotics (Universal Robots) and built a Flutter mobile workforce management application. Stack: Python, SQL, Matlab, Flutter. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-theforest
- Junior Data Analyst at PocketBI Cloud — January 2018 to January 2019 — Barcelona, Spain. Built enterprise data visualization dashboards in Tableau, Qlik, and PowerBI for multinational clients. Engineered custom Python scripts and ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and aggregate data from SQL, NoSQL, and raw data sources. Stack: Python, SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik. https://gimenezp.dev/#work-experience-pocketbi

## Academic background

- Exchange student, Bachelor's in Computer Science, 고려대학교 (Korea University), Seoul, South Korea — 2021–2022. Two semesters, focused on AI for natural language processing, machine learning applied to graphs, and 3D graphics. https://gimenezp.dev/#academic-ku
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona, Bellaterra, Spain — 2018–2021. 240 ECTS (4-year program), specialization in Computing, with focus on algorithms, performance, operating systems, computer architecture, AI, and scientific computation. Final project: a neural hash system to detect manipulated images. https://gimenezp.dev/#academic-uab
